description: Deliver a collected, completed child result artifact either by applying it to the local workspace or by preserving it on a new Git branch. A DAG result can be handed off only after the whole task graph completes.

propertyDescriptions.agentId: The child-agent identifier whose completed result should be handed off.
propertyDescriptions.destination: Apply the verified result locally or preserve it on a new branch.
propertyDescriptions.branchName: For a branch handoff, an optional explicit branch name.

guidance: Hand off only a completed child's result artifact; a conflicted handoff requires resolution before the result is delivered.
